name: Imouto Shiyoujo
source:
Puni-Soft's second title!

His little sister decides to live with the main character in order to go to school. He moved out of a studio apartment, and they began living together.

While pressing forward with his younger sister, who loves her Onii-chan, Onii-chan is gradually drawn to her even though she's his real little sister.

A siblings' forbidden love story...

How will he love her still youthful body and mind?

-MTL'd from DLSite
translation:
Puni-Soft的第二个作品！

为了上学，他的妹妹决定和主角住在一起。他搬出了单间公寓，他们开始住在一起。

在与深爱着小哥哥的妹妹一起前进的过程中，小哥哥逐渐被她吸引，尽管她是他真正的妹妹。

姐弟的禁忌爱情故事……

他将如何爱她依然年轻的身心？

-来自DLSite的
